maddeler.e:
اخترقن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَقْنَ (iḵtaraqna) /ix.ta.raq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اُخْتُرِقْنَ (uḵturiqna) /ux.tu.riq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اِخْتَرِقْنَ (iḵtariqna) /ix.ta.riq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
